* [`opentelemetry_reporter`](#opentelemetry_reporter): Manages the otel.yaml configuration file of the OpenTelemetry report processor

## Classes

### <a name="opentelemetry_reporter"></a>`opentelemetry_reporter`

Only keys that are set are written to the file. Leaving a parameter at
`undef` lets the processor fall back to the standard OTEL_* environment
variable and then to its built-in default. This matters for `headers`: a key
present in the file REPLACES OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS instead of merging.

The class does not touch puppet.conf or the puppetserver service. Add
`opentelemetry` to the `reports` setting and restart the server yourself,
with whatever tooling manages your server.

#### Examples

##### Minimal

```puppet
include opentelemetry_reporter
```

##### Send to a collector and enable traces

```puppet
class { 'opentelemetry_reporter':
  endpoint       => 'http://collector.example.com:4318',
  traces_enabled => true,
  manage_gems    => true,
}
```

##### <a name="-opentelemetry_reporter--enabled"></a>`enabled`

Data type: `Boolean`

Master switch of the processor.

Default value: `true`

##### <a name="-opentelemetry_reporter--endpoint"></a>`endpoint`

Data type: `Optional[String[1]]`

Base OTLP HTTP endpoint of the collector. Environment: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-opentelemetry_reporter--service_name"></a>`service_name`

Data type: `Optional[String[1]]`

The service.name of this server. Environment: OTEL_SERVICE_NAME.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-opentelemetry_reporter--timeout"></a>`timeout`

Data type: `Optional[Numeric]`

Export timeout in SECONDS. The environment variable is in milliseconds.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-opentelemetry_reporter--export_interval"></a>`export_interval`

Data type: `Optional[Numeric]`

How often the periodic reader exports, in seconds.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-opentelemetry_reporter--resource_attributes"></a>`resource_attributes`

Data type: `Optional[Hash[String[1], String]]`

Extra resource attributes, merged with OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES. Entries here win.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-opentelemetry_reporter--headers"></a>`headers`

Data type: `Optional[Hash[String[1], String]]`

Headers sent with each OTLP request, for example a token. Replaces
OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS when set. The file is not world readable for this reason.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-opentelemetry_reporter--environments"></a>`environments`

Data type: `Optional[Array[String[1]]]`

Allowlist of Puppet environments to report on. Unset or empty reports on all.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-opentelemetry_reporter--metrics_enabled"></a>`metrics_enabled`

Data type: `Optional[Boolean]`

Whether to export metrics. The processor defaults to true.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-opentelemetry_reporter--metrics_node_attribute"></a>`metrics_node_attribute`

Data type: `Optional[Boolean]`

Whether to attach puppet.node.name to metrics. Disabling bounds cardinality.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-opentelemetry_reporter--traces_enabled"></a>`traces_enabled`

Data type: `Optional[Boolean]`

Whether to export traces. The processor defaults to false because one span
is emitted per resource.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-opentelemetry_reporter--confdir"></a>`confdir`

Data type: `String[1]`

Directory holding puppet.conf, which is where the processor looks for otel.yaml.

Default value: `'/etc/puppetlabs/puppet'`

##### <a name="-opentelemetry_reporter--owner"></a>`owner`

Data type: `String[1]`

Owner of otel.yaml.

Default value: `'root'`

##### <a name="-opentelemetry_reporter--group"></a>`group`

Data type: `String[1]`

Group of otel.yaml. Must be able to read it, as the server runs as this group.

Default value: `'puppet'`

##### <a name="-opentelemetry_reporter--mode"></a>`mode`

Data type: `String[1]`

Mode of otel.yaml.

Default value: `'0640'`

##### <a name="-opentelemetry_reporter--ensure"></a>`ensure`

Data type: `Enum['present', 'absent']`

Whether otel.yaml should exist.

Default value: `'present'`

##### <a name="-opentelemetry_reporter--manage_gems"></a>`manage_gems`

Data type: `Boolean`

Install the OpenTelemetry gems into the puppetserver gem path. Leave this
off if you install them by hand with `puppetserver gem install`.

Default value: `false`

##### <a name="-opentelemetry_reporter--gem_ensure"></a>`gem_ensure`

Data type: `String[1]`

Ensure value for the gems when manage_gems is true.

Default value: `'installed'`
